methodology_other: A deep learning model was trained to detect per pixel building presence, fractional counts and height using Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery. We then ran inference for this model on stacks of 32 Sentinel-2 images centered around the 30th of June of each year (2016 - 2023) for most of the Global South. Only opaque-cloud-free images were used (according to the [QA60 band](https://sentiwiki.copernicus.eu/web/s2-processing)). Heights for non-building objects were masked out using the building presence output of the model. The accompanying [technical report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.11622) describes the training and evaluation of the model.
name: google-open-buildings-temporal
notes:
Source: https://sites.research.google/gr/open-buildings/temporal/

The Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal Dataset contains annual data spanning eight years (2016-2023) with building presence, fractional building counts, and building heights covering approximately 58 million square kilometers.

This dataset requires some knowledge with using scripts. The ZIP contains .txt files for over 130 countries and territories. The primary purpose of the data is to support comparison of building footprints across multiple years.
